I am a woman farming a very small piece of land here in Tigray. My maize plot is only 0.05 hectares, so I must be careful with money — fertilizer from the cooperative is expensive and sometimes comes late, but I will try to get a small amount of DAP and urea if I can, because our soil is tired. I keep a few animals, so I will spread manure I have collected through the dry season. I cannot afford hybrid seed every year and I do not trust buying it, so I will plant seed I saved from last harvest, and my husband and I will do most of the work ourselves with the ox.
